modern: Just as it happens to you in the amphitheatre and such places that the continual sight of the same things, and the sameness, make the spectacle tiresome, so it is in the whole of life; for all things above and below are the same and from the same. How long, then?
original: As it happens to thee in the amphitheatre and such places, that the continual sight of the same things, and the uniformity, make the spectacle wearisome, so it is in the whole of life; for all things above, below, are the same and from the same. How long then?
